events.content: The forged v99.99.99 exact-shape sibling is rejected without a valid signed attestation; valid stale releases advance and exact same-run reruns can recover from the immutable workflow artifact.

retrospective.summary: Added cryptographically verified GitHub artifact attestations for release baseline tags, exact source/tag-tree binding, same-workflow rerun artifact recovery, and regressions for forged exact-shape siblings and mismatched attestations. Node 22 release suite passed twice.
